68625-the-red-wizard-or-the-cave-captive.title: The Red Wizard Or The Cave Captive
68625-the-red-wizard-or-the-cave-captive.creator: Unknown
68625-the-red-wizard-or-the-cave-captive.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "You'll see what will come of it," growled Parsons, as he turned sulkily away. "Even if it is nothing but a girl, she has eyes and ears and feet, and can carry the news far. You might just as well spare a rattlesnake because it was little. They all have poison."

arxiv-2102-01880.title: High-throughput discovery of novel cubic crystal materials using deep generative neural networks
arxiv-2102-01880.creator: Yong Zhao, Mohammed Al-Fahdi, Ming Hu *, Edirisuriya MD Siriwardane, Yuqi Song, Alireza Nasiri, Jianjun Hu *
arxiv-2102-01880.description: Abstract High-throughput screening has become one of the major strategies for the discovery of novel functional materials. However, its effectiveness is severely limited by the lack of quantity and diversity of known materials deposited in the current materials repositories such as ICSD and OQMD.

arxiv-2103-16030.title: An Efficient Signal to Noise Approximation for Eccentric Inspiraling Binaries randall@g.harvard.edu alexandra.shelest@epfl.ch zxianyu@tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2103-16030.creator: [2mm] Department of Physics, Harvard University, 17 Oxford St., Cambridge, MA 02138, USA, [2mm] Institute of Physics, School of Basic Sciences, EPFL, 1015 Lausanne, Switzerland, [2mm] Department of Physics, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China
arxiv-2103-16030.description: Abstract Eccentricity has emerged as a potentially useful tool for helping to identify the origin of black hole mergers. However, owing to the large number of harmonics required to compute the amplitude of an eccentric signal, eccentric templates can be computationally very expensive, making statistical analyses to distinguish distributions from different formation channels very challenging.

arxiv-2104-09918.title: CrossATNet - A Novel Cross-Attention Based Framework for Sketch-Based Image Retrieval Journal: Journal of Image and Vision Computing
arxiv-2104-09918.creator: Ushasi Chaudhuri, Biplab Banerjee, Avik Bhattacharya, Mihai Datcu
arxiv-2104-09918.description: Abstract We propose a novel framework for cross-modal zero-shot learning (ZSL) in the context of sketch-based image retrieval (SBIR). Conventionally, the SBIR schema mainly considers simultaneous mappings among the two image views and the semantic side information. Therefore, it is desirable to consider fine-grained classes mainly in the sketch domain using highly discriminative and semantically rich feature space.

arxiv-2110-08280.title: Edge physics at the deconfined transition between a quantum spin Hall insulator and a superconductor
arxiv-2110-08280.creator: Ruochen Ma, Liujun Zou, Chong Wang
arxiv-2110-08280.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ruochen Ma, Liujun Zou, Chong Wang. We study the edge physics of the deconfined quantum phase transition (DQCP) between a spontaneous quantum spin Hall (QSH) insulator and a spin-singlet superconductor (SC). Although the bulk of this transition is in the same universality class as the paradigmatic deconfined Neel to valence-bond-solid transition, the boundary physics has a richer structure due to proximity to a quantum spin Hall state.

arxiv-2206-04862.title: Unique quantum impurity states driven by a vortex in topological superconductors
arxiv-2206-04862.creator: Wei Su, Rui Wang, Changfeng Chen, Xiaoqun Wang
arxiv-2206-04862.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Wei Su, Rui Wang, Changfeng Chen, Xiaoqun Wang. The interplay of magnetic impurity and vortex in a topological superconductor is of fundamental interest with major implications for implementing quantum computation. There are multiple degrees of freedom interacting with the impurity in the system, including the Majorana zero mode (MZM), the Caroli de Gennes Matricon (CdGM) states, and the electron bulk states that form Cooper pairs, which makes the impurity pinned vortex state elusive to date in topological superconductors.

arxiv-2206-07984.title: Vesyla-II: An Algorithm Library Development Tool for Synchoros VLSI Design Style
arxiv-2206-07984.creator: Yu Yang, Ahmed Hemani
arxiv-2206-07984.description: Abstract . High-level synthesis (HLS) has been researched for decades and is still limited to fast FPGA prototyping and algorithmic RTL generation. A feasible end-to-end system-level synthesis solution has never been rigorously proven. Modularity and composability are the keys to enabling such a system-level synthesis framework that bridges the huge gap between system-level specification and physical level design.

arxiv-2206-10355.title: On a conjecture of Deaconescu
arxiv-2206-10355.creator: Elchin Hasanalizade
arxiv-2206-10355.description: Abstract . In 2000 Deaconescu raised a question whether there exists a composite n n for which S 2 ​ ( n ) | ϕ ⁡ ( n ) − 1 S_{2}(n)|\phi(n)-1 , where ϕ ⁡ ( n ) \phi(n) is Euler’s function and S 2 ​ ( n ) S_{2}(n) is Schemmel’s totient function.

arxiv-2210-14224.title: Crafting the dynamical structure of synchronization by harnessing bosonic multilevel cavity QED
arxiv-2210-14224.creator: Riccardo J. Valencia-Tortora, Shane P. Kelly, Tobias Donner, Giovanna Morigi, Rosario Fazio, Jamir Marino
arxiv-2210-14224.description: Abstract Many-body cavity QED experiments are established platforms to tailor and control the collective responses of ensembles of atoms, interacting through one or more common photonic modes. The rich diversity of dynamical phases they can host, calls for a unified framework.

arxiv-2310-20239.title: Coded Caching Schemes for Multiaccess Topologies via Combinatorial Design
arxiv-2310-20239.creator: Minquan Cheng, Kai Wan, Petros Elia, and Giuseppe Caire
arxiv-2310-20239.description: Abstract This paper studies a multiaccess coded caching (MACC) where the connectivity topology between the users and the caches can be described by a class of combinatorial designs. Our model includes as special cases several MACC topologies considered in previous works.

arxiv-2406-07836.title: Quantum fluctuation on the worldsheet of probe string in BTZ black hole
arxiv-2406-07836.creator: Yu-Ting Zhou, Xiao-Mei Kuang
arxiv-2406-07836.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the second-order normal quantum fluctuation on the worldsheet of a probe string in the Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black hole. These fluctuations is treated as the projection of Hawking radiation on the worldsheet and indeed modify the action growth of the string.

arxiv-2408-05003.title: A patchy-particle 3-dimensional octagonal quasicrystal
arxiv-2408-05003.creator: Akie Kowaguchi, Savan Mehta, Jonathan P. K. Doye, Eva G. Noya
arxiv-2408-05003.description: Abstract We devise an ideal 3-dimensional octagonal quasicrystal that is based upon the 2-dimensional Ammann-Beenker tiling and that is potentially suitable for realization with patchy particles. Based on an analysis of its local environments we design a binary system of 8- and 5-patch particles that in simulations assembles into a 3-dimensional octagonal quasicrystal.

arxiv-2410-03626.title: Robust Offline Imitation Learning from Diverse Auxiliary Data Thanks: Work done outside Amazon.
arxiv-2410-03626.creator: Udita Ghosh ughos002@ucr.edu
arxiv-2410-03626.description: Abstract Offline imitation learning enables learning a policy solely from a set of expert demonstrations, without any environment interaction. To alleviate the issue of distribution shift arising due to the small amount of expert data, recent works incorporate large numbers of auxiliary demonstrations alongside the expert data.

arxiv-2503-02646.title: A Tight Regret Analysis of Non-Parametric Repeated Contextual Brokerage
arxiv-2503-02646.creator: François Bachoc
arxiv-2503-02646.description: Abstract We study a contextual version of the repeated brokerage problem. In each interaction, two traders with private valuations for an item seek to buy or sell based on the learner’s—a broker—proposed price, which is informed by some contextual information.

arxiv-2510-06552.title: Flipping the Dialogue: Training and Evaluating User Language Models
arxiv-2510-06552.creator: Tarek Naous, Philippe Laban, Wei Xu, Jennifer Neville
arxiv-2510-06552.description: Abstract Conversations with LMs involve two participants: a human user leading the conversation, and an LM assistant responding to the user’s request. To satisfy this specific role, LMs are post-trained to be helpful assistants – optimized to produce exhaustive and well-structured responses, free of ambiguity and grammar errors.

pmc-11353390.title: Food Supplements and Their Use in Elderly Subjects—Challenges and Risks in Selected Health Issues: A Narrative Review
pmc-11353390.creator: Maria João Campos, Magdalena Czlapka-Matyasik, Angelina Pena, María José Beriáin Apesteguía
pmc-11353390.description: The European population is ageing. Food Supplements (FSs) are foods with particular characteristics, consumed by elderly people for various purposes, including combating nutritional deficits. Their consumption in this age group, associated with a high prevalence of polypharmacy, can enhance interactions. Potential drug-food (or food supplements), drug-drug interactions and polypharmacy are common health issues among older adults.

pmc-11492558.title: GLP-1R activation attenuates the progression of pulmonary fibrosis via disrupting NLRP3 inflammasome/PFKFB3-driven glycolysis interaction and histone lactylation
pmc-11492558.creator: Chenyang Liu, Qun Zhang, Hong Zhou, Linling Jin, Chang Liu, Mingxia Yang, Xinyun Zhao, Wenqiu Ding, Weiping Xie, Hui Kong
pmc-11492558.description: BackgroundPulmonary fibrosis is a serious interstitial lung disease with no viable treatment except for lung transplantation. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R), commonly regarded as an antidiabetic target, exerts antifibrotic effects on various types of organ fibrosis. However, whether GLP-1R modulates the development and progression of pulmonary fibrosis remains unclear.

pmc-11496635.title: METASPACE-ML: Context-specific metabolite annotation for imaging mass spectrometry using machine learning
pmc-11496635.creator: Bishoy Wadie, Lachlan Stuart, Christopher M Rath, Bernhard Drotleff, Sergii Mamedov, Theodore Alexandrov
pmc-11496635.description: Imaging mass spectrometry is a powerful technology enabling spatial metabolomics, yet metabolites can be assigned only to a fraction of the data generated. METASPACE-ML is a machine learning-based approach addressing this challenge which incorporates new scores and computationally-efficient False Discovery Rate estimation.

pmc-11530782.title: Does adherence to exacerbation action plans matter? Insights from two COPD self-management studies
pmc-11530782.creator: Jade Schrijver, Tanja Effing, Joanke van Helden, Job van der Palen, Paul van der Valk, Marjolein Brusse-Keizer, Anke Lenferink
pmc-11530782.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionPatients' adherence is essential for COPD self-management, as beneficial effects can only be expected in adherent patients. We explored associations between patients’ adherence to COPD exacerbation action plans and health outcomes.Materials and methodsPooled COPD self-treatment intervention group data from two RCTs were analysed, only including patients who had ≥1 COPD exacerbation or started ≥1 course of oral corticosteroids over one-year follow-up.

pmc-11603284.title: Analyzing AZ-non-Maxwellian distributions in Earth’s magnetosphere: MMS observations
pmc-11603284.creator: A. A. Abid, M. S. Hussain, Amin Esmaeili, Abdullah Khan, S. Ali, M. Alharbi, Yas Al-Hadeethi, Nada M. Bedaiwi
pmc-11603284.description: A study of velocity distribution function in Earth’s magnetosphere is conducted using high-resolution measurements from the Magnetospheric Multiscale Spacecraft (MMS). The analysis focuses on the AZ-non-Maxwellian distribution that is a complex velocity-space structure, exhibiting a power-law distribution of moments. By imposing constraints on the spectral indices of the AZ-velocity distribution, the most suitable distribution for modeling Earth’s magnetosphere is determined.

pmc-11619470.title: The relationship of serum klotho levels and triglyceride glucose index-related indicators
pmc-11619470.creator: Yaoyao Zhou, Yaqi Wang, Fangli Li, Yiming Shi, Taotao Wu, Yingshuai Li
pmc-11619470.description: BackgroundKlotho, an anti-aging protein, is linked to energy metabolism. There is limited research on the association of serum klotho and triglyceride glucose (TyG) index-related indicators. Our research aims to investigate the relationship of serum klotho with TyG-BMI (body mass index), TyG-WC (waist circumference), and TyG-WHtR (waist-to-height ratio).

pmc-13092707.title: De-escalation of elective radiotherapy guided by FDG-PET lowers modeled late swallowing-related toxicity in head and neck cancer

pmc-13092707.description: Highlights•FDG-PET–guided volumetric de-escalation reduced modeled swallowing-related toxicity.•Reduced elective and involved-node irradiation are predicted to reduce dysphagia.•Hypopharyngeal and laryngeal cancers showed the greatest predicted benefit.•Combining protons with de-escalation may further enhance organ-at-risk sparing.•Effect estimates may inform patient selection for future de-escalation trials.

pmc-13415364.title: Association between the skeletal muscle-to-visceral fat area ratio and liver fibrosis risk in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13415364.creator: Jingru Liu, Xitong Jiao, Lu Liu, Anqi Chen, Qixue Kang, Jiayue Guo, Yuxing Wang, Yanmeng Qi, Lili You
pmc-13415364.description: BackgroundNon-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is highly prevalent and closely linked to metabolic dysfunction, with progressive liver fibrosis driving adverse outcomes. Conventional obesity metrics such as body mass index (BMI) and waist circumference inadequately capture body-composition imbalance. The skeletal muscle-to-visceral fat area ratio (SVR) integrates muscle reserve and visceral adiposity and may better reflect metabolic risk.

pmc-13538274.title: High Rates of Return to Soccer After Primary Hip Arthroscopic Labral Repair for Femoroacetabular Impingement Syndrome
pmc-13538274.creator: Akeem Henry, Louis Kang, John‐Rudolph Smith, Malik Dancy, Gavin Ward, Bruce A Levy, Mario Hevesi, Aaron J Krych, Kelechi R Okoroha
pmc-13538274.description: PurposeTo evaluate return‐to‐sport (RTS) outcomes and patient‐reported outcomes in soccer players after primary hip arthroscopic labral repair for femoroacetabular impingement syndrome.MethodsAll patients undergoing primary hip arthroscopy with labral repair for femoroacetabular impingement syndrome from 2011 to 2022 were retrospectively reviewed. Patients who had a minimum 2‐year follow‐up, played soccer, and had no prior hip surgery were included.

pmc-13670271.creator: Suellen Rodrigues Maia, Silvano Salgueiro Geraldes, Fábio dos Santos Nogueira, Maria Gabriela Picelli de Azevedo, Reiner Silveira de Moraes, Julia Franco Ferreira, Teresa Alessandra de Lima Núñez, Regina Kiomi Takahira, Alessandra Melchert, Adriano Sakai Okamoto, Priscylla Tatiana Chalfun Guimarães-
pmc-13670271.description: As in humans, therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) has been investigated in veterinary medicine for managing immune-mediated diseases such as canine visceral leishmaniasis (CVL). TPE may improve clinical outcomes by removing circulating immune complexes and excess antibodies; however, its physiological effects must be understood to ensure safety.

pmc-13678680.title: A novel nanoparticle-based co-delivery system of Fritillaria persica L. extract and gemcitabine for inhibiting breast cancer progression
pmc-13678680.creator: Reyhaneh Arefimehr, Mehrad Zibaei Moghadam, Negar Jamshidi, Nazanin Jamshidi, Yohann Corvis
pmc-13678680.description: Breast cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, highlighting the urgent need for more effective and less toxic therapeutic strategies. In the present study, a novel nanotherapeutic platform composed of aqueous Fritillaria persica L. (FP) extract and gemcitabine (Gem)-loaded chitosan (CS) nanoparticles (FP/Gem/CS-NPs) was successfully developed and evaluated against MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cell lines.
